summary: Improve office workflows, records control, and service tracking with practical exercises. Explore the course outline and enrol.
lede: Office administration training helps office managers, supervisors, and coordinators organize requests, records, and workplace services. Participants practise mapping request workflows, clarifying responsibilities, controlling records and procedures, tracking supplies, and reviewing service measures to support consistent day-to-day administration.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for professionals responsible for keeping office administration, information, supplies, and workplace services organized and traceable.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with routine office administration is useful. No coding or programming is required; exercises use office workflow examples and spreadsheet concepts.
